days.title: Arrival + Port de Pollenca
days.theme: Keep arrival deliberately light: waterfront, Pine Walk, strong dinner.

segments.title: easyJet EJU7384 OPO -> PMI
segments.description: Arrive PMI 11:20. Bag collection then Hertz.

segments.title: Hertz pickup at PMI
segments.description: Skoda Karoq class or similar. Photograph all panels/wheels; verify transmission, excess, fuel, deposit, mileage.

segments.title: Drive to Port de Pollenca Airbnb
segments.description: Planning 50-60 min. Public parking + short luggage walk; waterfront zone is traffic-free.

segments.title: Optional caffeine + pastry
segments.description: Specialty coffee and bakes if needed after travel.

segments.title: Port de Pollenca beach + Pine Walk
segments.description: Default arrival-day plan. Playa de Muro remains an optional high-energy pivot, not the default.

segments.title: Dinner at Ca'n Josep
segments.description: Sea-view seafood/Mallorcan dinner. Request window/sea-view table.

days.title: Formentor without parking stress
days.theme: Use TIB 334 during the 2026 private-car restriction window.

segments.title: Coffee + breakfast near Airbnb
segments.description: Keep breakfast relaxed; pack water, beach gear and a snack.

segments.title: TIB 334 toward Formentor
segments.description: Walk roughly 5-10 min to Port de Pollenca Centre stop. Confirm live timetable the same week.

segments.title: Mirador Es Colomer
segments.description: 30-40 min for cliffs, bay and photos.

segments.title: Far de Formentor
segments.description: Use next 334 service from Mirador. Target about 45 min.

segments.title: Platja de Formentor
segments.description: Main chill block: swim, loungers if available, light lunch/snacks.

segments.title: TIB 334 back to Port de Pollenca
segments.description: Choose 15:00 or later service based on energy. Confirm live schedule.

segments.title: Dinner at No.31
segments.description: Modern dinner + cocktail night.

days.title: Pollenca market + Sa Calobra by sea
days.theme: Market morning, transfer luggage, then Sa Calobra by boat; road version is weather backup.

segments.title: Check out Airbnb
segments.description: Load car from public parking and drive to Pollenca old town.

segments.title: Pollenca Sunday Market
segments.description: Browse Plaça Major and surrounding lanes; add Calvari Steps if comfortable.

segments.title: Coffee at Bo's
segments.description: Specialty coffee/brunch-style stop in old town.

segments.title: Drive to Hotel Salino Port Soller
segments.description: Planning 50-60 min. Store luggage; early check-in until 13:00 is subject to availability.

segments.title: Port de Soller -> Sa Calobra
segments.description: Barcos Azules. Approx 1 hour. Confirm by phone/day before due to weather.

estimatedCost.basis: adult roundtrip list price before online discount

segments.title: Sa Calobra + Torrent de Pareis
segments.description: Walk rock tunnels; beach/canyon; keep lunch simple.

segments.title: Return to Port de Soller
segments.description: Operator publishes 16:40/16:45 depending page; reconfirm day before.

segments.title: Dinner at S'Amfora
segments.description: Waterfront seafood/paella; good post-boat dinner.

days.title: Tramuntana villages
days.theme: Efficient one-direction mountain loop: Fornalutx -> Deia -> Son Marroig -> Valldemossa.

segments.title: Fornalutx
segments.description: Slow village walk, stone lanes and artisan shops.

segments.title: Corella Cafe
segments.description: Excellent specialty coffee + house bakes.

segments.title: Deia
segments.description: 60-90 min for stone lanes, galleries and viewpoints. Cala Deia remains intentionally skipped.

segments.title: Son Marroig
segments.description: Optional interior; exterior/viewpoint recommended if weather is clear.

segments.title: Valldemossa
segments.description: Spend the longest block here: lanes, shops, Charterhouse only if interested.

segments.title: Coca de patata + coffee
segments.description: Coffee at Barbaflorida; traditional coca de patata at Ca n Molinas.

segments.title: Return to Hotel Salino
segments.description: Planning 35 min; use live route.

segments.title: Dinner at Goia
segments.description: More modern/trendy final Soller night; Ses Oliveres is the reliable backup.

days.title: Es Trenc transfer day
days.theme: Beach on the transfer south, then hotel reset and Puerto Portals dinner.

segments.title: Check out Hotel Salino
segments.description: Drive south; do not add Banyalbufar/Estellencs to this route.

segments.title: Es Trenc
segments.description: About 3 hours; allow time for paid parking/access and a simple lunch.

segments.title: Check in Pure Salt Garonda
segments.description: Planning 35-45 min from Es Trenc. Important: confirm overnight parking plan with hotel; current listings show no on-site parking.

segments.title: Pool / spa / Playa de Palma
segments.description: Use hotel time deliberately before evening.

segments.title: Drive to Puerto Portals
segments.description: Allow approx 25-35 min depending traffic; use live routing.

segments.title: Dinner at Yara Portals
segments.description: Japanese-Mediterranean, sushi/robata, marina terrace and cocktails.

days.title: Southeast calas + Santanyi
days.theme: Do the tiny/difficult cove first, then relax at Cala Llombards, polished Santanyi lunch, return Hertz early.

segments.title: Leave Pure Salt Garonda
segments.description: Take water, shoes and beach kit. Use live parking/access info for Calo des Moro.

segments.title: Calo des Moro + Cala s Almunia
segments.description: Go early; photos and short swim. Proper shoes; access can be steep.

segments.title: Cala Llombards
segments.description: Easier beach block after the difficult cove.

segments.title: Santanyi lunch at Restaurant Laudat
segments.description: Polished courtyard lunch; fish/seafood/vegetables fit preferences.

segments.title: Optional coffee/cake at Can Gelat
segments.description: Use only if you want an afternoon caffeine boost.

segments.title: Return to Pure Salt Garonda
segments.description: Planning 40-50 min. Shower and rest.

segments.title: Return Hertz at PMI
segments.description: Contract deadline 23:00; target 21:30-22:00 to protect buffer. Uber back to hotel.

days.title: Car-free Palma finale
days.theme: Sleep in, hotel beach/pool, then old town, early dinner, theatrical bar and craft cocktails.

segments.title: Hotel breakfast + Playa de Palma
segments.description: No car today. Slow morning and pool/beach.

segments.title: Uber to Palma Old Town
segments.description: Planning 15-20 min. Hotel is also served by airport/Palma buses, but Uber is simplest.

segments.title: La Seu + old town + Passeig del Born
segments.description: Cathedral exterior/interior as desired, shopping and lanes.

segments.title: Coffee before 4 PM
segments.description: Mistral for coffee quality; Rosevelvet if pastries matter more and timing allows.

segments.title: Early dinner at El Camino
segments.description: Chef-led tapas counter. Seafood/vegetable plates easy; pork items optional.

segments.title: One drink at Bar Abaco
segments.description: Go for visual spectacle/ambience; no reservation.

segments.title: After Landing Cocktail Art
segments.description: Make this the quality-cocktail stop.

segments.title: Uber back to Pure Salt Garonda
segments.description: Keep final night enjoyable but not too late before 07:05 flight.

segments.title: Uber to PMI
segments.description: Target airport arrival around 05:00. Pre-book/confirm ride the evening before.

segments.title: Vueling VY3436 PMI -> LIS
segments.description: Arrive Lisbon 08:15.
